title: kate-syntax: wire the Klipper G-Code definition into VENDORED
summary: Add include_str of klipper-gcode.xml to the VENDORED list in vendored.rs, add the SOURCES.md row for klipper-gcode.xml, and add a test that loads Klipper G-Code by name and builds its Highlighter. This is wiring 1 of 8 in wiring wave 8 of 15. The xml file stays as PKT-0307 copied it.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: vendored.rs has one test module named tests. Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Add include_str!("../definitions/klipper-gcode.xml") as the last entry of VENDORED. Keep every earlier entry in its order. Add one row to the table in SOURCES.md after the last row: | klipper-gcode.xml | data/syntax/klipper-gcode.xml | 6d8ab7945958e7354295db7f399cce06f7de7571 | MIT |. Do not change another row. The test klipper_gcode_is_vendored calls vendored_repository, unwraps it, finds by_name("Klipper G-Code"), asserts definition(id).license is MIT, and asserts Highlighter::new(&repo, id) is Ok. The existing test every_vendored_definition_loads_and_links stays green. Do not edit klipper-gcode.xml. Do not edit repository.rs. Wait until PKT-0307 and PKT-0428 are on main. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. When Highlighter::new returns RegexError::Unsupported, stop, keep the xml unchanged, and open an issue that names the pattern. Keep the change under about 20 lines.
